name: cartography-plugins
description: Workspace-agnostic Claude Code tooling: cartography of a repository by functionality, and a challenge-then-interview workflow turning a raw idea into a functional spec.

plugins.name: cartography
plugins.description: Maps a repository by functionality rather than by code: an index of what lives where, one detail entry per usecase, and the refusal surface. Ships the cartographer and scout agents, the format specification with its templates, and a validator.

plugins.name: feature-spec
plugins.description: Turns a raw product idea into a functional spec through a mandatory challenge, then interview, then write sequence. Ships the spec-writer agent and the workflow-feature-spec skill with its template. Never invents a missing fact, never settles an open reflection, never publishes anywhere.
